# Navimower Map Card 0.3.3-beta1

This prerelease is a focused mower-artwork test build on top of stable 0.3.2.

## Fixed

- Rebuilt the manual `i_dark` mower artwork directly from the supplied original 60 px SVG source (`16076.svg`).
- The embedded image now preserves that source asset's transparent 2x PNG raster instead of the earlier WebP conversion.
- The corrected artwork keeps the same 85x120 geometry, map-size normalization, heading rotation and manual `mower_icon: i_dark` selection behavior.
- Other mower artwork, automatic model detection, History, Notifications, Schedule and mower controls are unchanged.

## Packaging

The beta continues to ship as a single HACS runtime file, `navimower-map-card.js`. No SVG/PNG helper assets or temporary preparation files are included in the release tree.

Install `0.3.3-beta1` as a prerelease and verify `mower_icon: i_dark` before this fix is promoted to stable.
